ct.hub.name: Contract transparency
ct.hub.description: Explains why a CPU fails a contract's requirements, shows the real probability of winning a tender (a 40% chance against a 60% one is 21%), asks for confirmation before a risky offer and keeps a log of contracts.
ct.param.confirmMode: Offer confirmation (0 - always, 1 - risky only, 2 - never)
ct.param.confirmMode.tip: When to open the review screen before an offer is sent to a contract: 0 - always, 1 - only when a risk is found, 2 - never. Offers of the automation and of the AI never open it.
ct.param.showActualProbability.tip: Append the real probability of winning the tender to the probability in the contract window, for example "40% (actual 21%)".
ct.param.notifyTenderLoss.tip: Show a notification when the player's offer lost a tender on the review date. The results go to the log in any case.
ct.param.logAutomation.tip: Write the decisions of the contract automation on December 31 to the log: which offers were sent and why the others were skipped.

ct.hub.page.title: Contract transparency: settings
ct.hub.help.modes.title: Offer confirmation
ct.hub.help.modes:
Before an offer goes into a contract the mod can show a review screen: the contract and the CPU, the volume, the payment, the lines needed, the profit, the fine for breaking the contract and the risks it found.
"Always" opens the screen for every offer. "Only risky" opens it only when a risk is found: not enough lines, a contract at a loss, a margin below the threshold of the contract automation, a low probability, a fine for breaking the contract larger than the company's cash, or "Automatically cancel offers" about to withdraw the offer. "Never" sends the offer at once, as in the plain game.
The "Send Offer" and "Cancel Offer" buttons of the contract window stay as they were. The offers of the automation and of the AI never open the review screen.
ct.hub.help.actual.title: Actual probability
ct.hub.help.actual:
The percentage in the contract window is the chance of one offer. The game goes through the offers from the most powerful by IPS to the weakest and takes each one with a probability equal to its chance; if nobody is taken, the round is repeated. So the probability of winning a tender is not the percentage in the window.
The mod appends it to the game's own text: "Probability: 40% (actual 21%)". The "Why?" button opens the breakdown: the requirements of the contract with numbers, the table of offers in the order of the draw and the multipliers of other mods.
ct.hub.help.example: Example. A competitor has a 60% chance, you have 40%, and it goes first. In one round you win with a probability of 0.4 x 0.4 = 16%, and the round repeats with a probability of 0.4 x 0.6 = 24%. The result: 0.16 / (1 - 0.24) = 21% for you and 79% for the competitor, although the window shows you 40%.
ct.hub.help.log.title: Log
ct.hub.help.log:
The mod records the offers sent and cancelled, the decisions of the "Automatically sign contracts" switch on December 31 (what was sent and why the rest was skipped), the offers withdrawn by "Automatically cancel offers", the deals signed between companies and the results of the tenders: the winner, the chances and the reason for a loss.
The results of the tenders come in one letter, "Tender results", and, after a loss, in a notification. The log is kept in the save; open it with the "Log" button of the contract window or with the buttons below. "Automation preview" shows what will be sent on December 31, before the day itself.
